content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services at 911. For other cases, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center by dialing 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Medications should be discarded properly when they are expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
